sampling_method: Every own-result cell in frame_locations was assigned a contiguous 1-based index in reading order (location order below; row-major within a table, left to right across a row's own-result columns; for Figure 5 and Figure 7, which print a per-point numeric label at every marker, all points of the first-printed curve/subplot in x order, then all points of the second in x order), giving a population of 1..246. random.seed(20260810); random.sample(range(1, 247), 15) drew {1, 2, 13, 14, 25, 29, 83, 91, 99, 107, 108, 122, 148, 153, 241}; each label below records its draw as frame_index.
